facts.fact: President Mnangagwa said the Zimbabwe Centre for High Performance Computing (ZCHPC) national HPC data center at the University of Zimbabwe, run by ZCHPC as custodian of national HPC infrastructure, already hosts the Ministry of Health and Child Care's Impilo Electronic Health Records and Telemedicine platform, and the Civil Registry is integrated with it (date is the commissioning of Phase 2, 2025-08-15, as the article gives no other).
